description: What the surface actually skis like at a resort — Dry powder, Soft, Packed, Crust, Spring, Wet, Wind-affected or No snow — from SnowSure's SLF SNOWPACK simulation at three elevations, with the reason and how confident it is. This is the question snowfall totals cannot answer: 30 cm that fell dry and 30 cm that fell warm and refroze are the same number and a different day. MODELED, not measured, and it describes the surface only — it is not an avalanche assessment (use get_avalanche). Returns 'not available' where the simulation has not been verified for that region yet.

band.description: Elevation band for the layer detail. Defaults to mid, which is also the band the headline label is read from.

resort.description: Same as `slug`: the resort slug or name. Pass either one.

slug.description: Resort slug or name, e.g. "portillo" or "Portillo". Required unless `resort` is given.

name: get_snow_quality

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).
